evidence: The Amnis AI analysis software package takes advantage of deep learning using convolutional neural networks to greatly simplify analysis and accurately identify even the most subtle of cell differences.

Machine learning modules add the power of computer learning and the ability to create experiment-specific super features tailored to maximize separation of critical populations using the thousands of features in an IDEAS analysis.

In November 2022, we launched Cytek Cloud, a digital ecosystem that supports full spectrum flow cytometry research from panel design to data acquisition, seamlessly integrating with our SpectroFlo software.
Our employees and personnel use generative AI and/or automated decision-making technologies to perform their work
We have and will continue to incorporate AI and/or ML technologies into our business operations and products and services
ai_positioning.summary: Cytek intègre l'IA et le machine learning dans ses produits d'analyse de cytométrie en flux (logiciels IDEAS et Amnis AI avec réseaux de neurones convolutifs) et dans ses opérations internes, tout en reconnaissant les risques réglementaires et opérationnels associés.
